content.text:
Improve this reference figure for a MICRO/ISCA/HPCA computer architecture paper about a GPU prefetcher called GRASP. Keep overall layout structure, improve quality.

CRITICAL SPELLING: "Chain Table (CT)", "Target Table (TT)", "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)", "IMAD.WIDE", "LDG.E", "SpMV"

KEY IMPROVEMENTS:
1. TT (Target Table): Add "Idx" and "Type" columns (5 columns total: Idx, V, Base Address, Scale, Type). PURPLE #6C3483 header, WHITE text. Data rows: Row 0 (0, valid-green, c[0x0][0x180], 4B, f32), Row 1 (1, valid-green, 0x7FC4B7E40000, 4B, f32), Row 2 (2, valid-green, 0x7FC4B8100000, 8B, f64), Row 3 (3, invalid-gray, dashes). Annotation below TT: "CAM: lookup by (base, scale)"
2. CT (Chain Table): BLUE #2B5EA7 header, WHITE text. 32 entries. Grouped columns with light tinted sub-headers: Identification (light blue #E8F0FE): V, Index PC; Target Mapping (light purple #F0E8F8): tt_idx[0], [1], [2], K; Stride Learning (light gold #FFF8E1): Iter Stride, Stride Valid. Data rows: (valid, 0x03d0, 0, -, -, 1, 64B, TRUE), (valid, 0x03e0, 0, -, -, 1, 64B, TRUE), (valid, 0x0A20, 0, 1, -, 2, 16B, TRUE)
3. IST block: Blue #2B5EA7 outlined box, white background. Title "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)" above. Show: PC 0x03d0 Warp 0: iter i A1=0x...4864, iter i+1 A2=0x...48A4, stride = A2-A1 = 0x40 = 64B. Note: "Any warp can contribute". Arrow pointing LEFT to CT stride column.
4. CT->TT CONVERGENCE ARROWS: Multiple BLACK solid arrows from CT tt_idx column pointing RIGHT to TT rows. 3 arrows from CT rows converging to TT row 0. Bold annotation: "16 CT entries -> 1 TT entry (many-to-one)"
5. SpMV code box (upper left, gray background) and SASS Assembly box (upper right, gray background) keep similar content to reference image. Color-code SASS lines: blue for index LDG, purple for IMAD.WIDE, amber for data LDG. Right-side brackets labeling each group.

STYLE: White background. NO title at top. NO shadows. NO gradients. NO 3D. Colored table headers with WHITE text inside. Green #5AA469 small squares for valid bits. Monospace font for hex values. Print-friendly. Bottom legend bar.
